thread:
alex: Heads up: two customers reported they clicked Grant in Support Console but credits never appeared in billing.

mona: ids?

alex: ACCT-9001 and ACCT-9002. UI shows green toast and we get X-Request-Id header, but /admin/billing/transactions returns nothing.

ops-bot: [Alert] backoffice.processor.failures=5 window=15m service=backoffice-processor

devin: env?

alex: prod. I clicked once for ACCT-9001 via Support Console. browser request id: req-20250618-7f2c

mona: I pulled the worker logs for that window. Job enqueued but failed with TransactionConflictError. Stack:
```
Error: TransactionConflictError
 at CreditService.applyCredit (/srv/backoffice/src/services/creditService.js:198)
 caused by: idempotency: duplicate key detected
```

alex: but there is no credit_transactions row for ACCT-9001. why duplicate?

devin: quick summary of grant flow: UI -> backoffice API (responds 200 on enqueue) -> worker consumes job -> write credit_transactions row -> mark idempotency key as applied. If tombstone is written early, worker might mark as applied even if DB tx rolled back.

mona: I grep idempotency store for req-20250618-7f2c. Found key with status="applied" at 2025-06-18T21:03:10Z, but no matching DB row. That matches a tombstone written before commit.

alex: that explains missing row but dedupe preventing retry.

devin: root cause looks like race where worker writes idempotency.applied before ensuring DB commit finished. If DB rollback happens we leave a false-applied tombstone.

mona: scope: saw 5 failures in last 12h; CS has 3 open tickets.

alex: mitigation options?

devin: short term: flip feature flag to disable idempotency dedupe for grant endpoint, so retries will reapply until we ship a proper fix. alternative is to run a reconciliation job to find applied tombstones without DB rows and requeue.

kayla: I can flip the flag for grants for 30 minutes to clear backlog. Will coordinate with oncall.

ops-bot: [Info] deploy.hotfix staging -> success branch=hotfix/fix-credit-dedupe

devin: I'll change tombstone write order in the worker: write idempotency as applied only after DB tx commit returns success. Quick PR created: #1189. Also adding monitoring: alert if tombstone written but DB row absent after 20s.

mona: support playbook until fix lands: if UI says granted but billing empty, ask for X-Request-Id and run:
```
SELECT key, status, created_at FROM idempotency_keys WHERE key = 'req-20250618-7f2c';
SELECT * FROM credit_transactions WHERE request_id = 'req-20250618-7f2c';
```
If tombstone present and no transaction row, escalate with request id to eng for requeue.

alex: manual grant script (admin-only) if needed:
```
./tools/manual_grant --acct ACCT-9001 --amount 200 --skip_idempotency
```
Use only after confirming no duplicate transaction.

finance: please watch for manual grants so we can reconcile.

ops-bot: [Info] prod.flag.grants.dedupe.disabled=true at 2025-06-18T21:22Z

devin: toggled dedupe-bypass in prod, replaying failed jobs. Watching queue.

ops-bot: [Info] prod.queue.grants processed=33 failures=0 last_job=req-20250618-7f2c

mona: confirmed credits applied for ACCT-9001 and ACCT-9002. CS notified customers and offered apology credit.

alex: action items: (1) merge PR #1189 to ensure tombstone written post-commit, (2) add a nightly reconciliation job to find tombstones without DB rows, (3) add alert when tombstone written without DB commit within 20s, (4) update support playbook.

devin: PR opened and requesting reviews from @mona @alex. ETA merge: 24-36 hours.

kayla: adding CS + finance to postmortem. closing when PR merged and alert in place. :thumbsup:
